description: Verdict of the Q&A answer judge.
name: qa_answer_verdict

status.description: scored in the normal case; see STATUS.

key_points.description: Facts a correct answer must contain, each starting with MAIN or SECONDARY and ending with its source in brackets.

supported.description: Answer claims confirmed by the ground truth, each with its source.

unsupported_or_wrong.description: Each item starts with CONTRADICTED: or NOT FOUND:, then MATERIAL or MINOR, then the claim and why.

missing.description: Key points absent from the answer.

figures_viewed.description: Artifact IDs of figures opened with image_read.

reason.description: Two to four sentences explaining the score.

score.description: Single overall score, decided last from the lists.
